name: Brekka
title: Keeper of the Foreman's Rest
examine: Fell-country born. Her day-book records who went out to the burn and who came home. Her brother went out unrecorded once, up north. The book is her answer.
lines: Sign the book before you drink. Going out or coming home, sign it.
Soup is what the road brought us. Some days that is a long story.
Every name in my book came home. I mean to keep it that way.
